_notice: Backing entries for figures written in docs/writeup/uncertainlp-2026-short.tex. Read by scripts/check_paper_claims.py, which extracts EVERY numeric leaf from the paper and fails any figure this file does not back. This file is not the scope - the paper is. Adding an entry cannot hide a figure, and omitting one cannot exempt it.
_how_to_use: One entry per figure as the paper writes it. 'pointer' is a dotted path into 'artifact'; 'render' turns the stored value into the written token; 'configuration' maps pointers in the SAME artifact to the values that must hold. A configuration the artifact does not record cannot be declared, and a mismatch fails even when the value matches - that is the defect class this guard exists for. If a figure has no artifact carrying both, it FAILS: compute it into an artifact, or stop writing it.
